Messages.Author: Baaliprimogen
Messages.Body:
Hi
If Meth A playes Anathema on Meth B's vampire. If Meth A is ousted
does Anathema also go?
regards

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. It is a minion card, so it is controlled by the controller of the
minion it is on.
When A is ousted, only the cards A controls are removed.
